header.name: Nikhil Ganpat Navghade
header.title: FIELD APPLICATION ENGINEER | SEMICONDUCTOR SYSTEMS | CUSTOMER ENGINEERING

summary:
Semiconductor and Customer Engineering professional with 12+ years of experience spanning semiconductor products, radar SoCs, RF/mixed-signal systems, embedded platforms, system integration, validation, and customer-facing engineering.

Currently working on semiconductor radar products at NXP, with previous experience as FAE & Technical Sales at Calterah, supporting customers from product selection and system architecture through integration, validation, troubleshooting, and deployment.

Strong ability to translate customer requirements into technical solutions and coordinate issues across customers, R&D, applications, product, quality, and marketing teams. Experienced in semiconductor product evaluation, system bring-up, laboratory characterization, automated validation, root-cause analysis, technical presentations, and customer workshops.
